Lydia (marketing): Quick flag for Friday KPI review 
Dashboard shows launch-post sessions +48% but MQL headline swing depends on attribution model. We need a single exec-facing line; thoughts? https://dash.redwood/boards/launch_bench :mag:
Owen (growth): what's the delta? last-touch vs multi-touch? execs want one crisp number but we should surface sensitivity.
Tara (analytics): quick snapshot: last-touch=912 MQLs, 14d time-decay=1,118 (+22.6%). Per-channel time-decay lifts: social +42%, email +5%, organic unchanged.
Lydia (marketing): that's sizable. Also noticed inbound routing changed Wed -> SDR A got more launch leads; routing latency may affect qualified timing. Might show up as a temporary dip.
Hank (ops): dashbot: note routing rule change applied 2025-05-07T14:12Z; no ingestion errors but slight delay in CRM sync for routed-to-SDR-A lanes between 14:12-14:47Z. Reprocess not needed but annotation recommended.
dashbot: reminder weekly-kpi-deck due Friday 09:00 PT.
Owen (growth): proposal: headline = conservative last-touch, single parenthetical note with time-decay sensitivity (+23%). Appendix: per-channel time-decay table + routing note. Keeps execs accurate and avoids overclaiming.
Tara (analytics): I can produce appendix CSV and a tiny methodology blurb: "time-decay half-life=3d, window=14d" and attach per-channel rows. Also include a small routing-latency table showing SDR assignment latency for the week.
Lydia (marketing): please do Tara. Also include benchmark narrative: compare this launch-post to Feb benchmark (same audience) in appendix so PMs see trend.
Hank (ops): I'll add a dashboard annotation for the routing change and confirm CRM sync delays are resolved. Also adding a one-line alert to routing runbook to avoid silent lane changes.
execbot: note Deck ready window Friday 07:30 PT for final review.
Lydia (marketing): thanks all. Action list: Tara -> appendix CSV + method note; Hank -> dashboard annotation and runbook update; Owen -> 1-sentence headline options for execs; Lydia -> finalize slide with conservative headline and appendix link. I'll send final by 07:30 PT. :rocket:
